description: Every nestor-home repository keeps the Nestor packages it depends on current, merged as soon as its CI passes. Other dependencies are left to people.

packageRules.description: Only Nestor's own packages are followed.
Nestor's packages: the range moves with each release, and GitHub merges the pull request once CI passes.

customManagers.description: The server release a satellite SDK or template runs the conformance suite with.
The server release the site serves its schemas and OAuth relay from.
